title: Camera with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='30' width='72' height='50' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#3b5bdb'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='30' width='72' height='14' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#5c7cfa'/>
  <!-- viewfinder bump -->
  <rect x='36' y='20' width='28' height='14' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#4c6ef5'/>
  <!-- lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='22' fill='#748ffc'/>
  <!-- lens inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='16' fill='#e8ecff'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='11' fill='#364fc7'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='53' r='4' fill='#9bb0ff'/>
  <!-- little lens dot -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 76 Q50 88 62 76' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- flash unit -->
  <rect x='74' y='23' width='10' height='8' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#ffd43b'/>
  <!-- flash glow -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='27' r='3' fill='#fff3bf'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='20' y='23' width='12' height='8' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- side detail -->
  <rect x='76' y='48' width='6' height='14' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#4c6ef5'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='76' r='4' fill='#ff8787' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='76' r='4' fill='#ff8787' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
